data.description:
## Context

`plugins/dso/agents/second-source-verifier.md` is a fully-built audit agent that confirms three mechanisms were actually used during each story closure: (1) typed-enum verifier P1 field, (2) deterministic narrative renderer (`render-closure-narrative.sh`), (3) story-handoff gate (`check-story-handoff.sh`). Consumer helper `plugins/dso/scripts/check-second-source-report.sh` exists. The agent is fully callable today as a manual dispatch.

PR-G/H/I (Week 3 audit remediation) updated `AGENTS.md` to remove the vague "in-progress epic for full wire-up" annotation and replaced it with a concrete deferred-decision list. This ticket tracks resolving that deferred decision.

## Prerequisites (must be satisfied before wiring)

1. **Epic `a03c-d55e-1393-4f27` formally closes** — the substantive work is done (9/10 stories closed as of 2026-05-19); only the docs story `105c-ab76-0311-4009` remains. Wait for it to close.
2. **Decision: advisory-vs-blocking verdict semantics** — when second-source-verifier returns `SECOND_SOURCE_VERDICT: FAIL`, does the sprint closure flow halt (blocking) or just log the finding (advisory)? Recommend advisory-by-default with a config key `sprint.second_source_blocking=true` to opt in to blocking.
3. **Step 2c refinement** — the agent's current "benefit-of-doubt PASS" for stories with no `depends_on` link could mask real handoff-gate skips when epics have linear stories without explicit dependency annotations. Need a more precise check (e.g., "is this story preceded by another closed story in the same epic? if so, check the handoff trailer regardless of depends_on link").

## Integration point

`plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md` Step 18 area, after `dso:completion-verifier` returns `P1=PASS`. Dispatch `dso:second-source-verifier` with `epic_id` set to the closing epic; read the JSON report; act on `summary_verdict`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: `dso:second-source-verifier` is dispatched at the appropriate point in sprint closure flow, with the verdict consumed via `check-second-source-report.sh`.
- AC2: The advisory-vs-blocking semantics are documented in CLAUDE.md or sprint SKILL.md (whichever lands the wiring).
- AC3: Step 2c is updated to distinguish "no depends_on by design" from "depends_on was skipped" and only PASS when the former is true.
- AC4: `plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md:47` updated to reflect the new automated wire-up; "Manual-invocation only" wording removed.
data.title: Wire dso:second-source-verifier into sprint Phase 9
